subject.title: feat: add LLMTR provider for Turkey-hosted and global models

question: Should LLMTR be accepted as a bundled OpenClaw provider, or should it ship as the contributor's external plugin using the existing public SDK seams?
rationale: The implementation is an optional third-party provider and the repository policy prefers plugin ownership when current seams suffice; only maintainers can decide whether LLMTR warrants an exception to that distribution boundary.

options.title: Use the external plugin path
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core unchanged and publish the already-prepared LLMTR provider as an external plugin with installation, credential, update, and live smoke-proof guidance.

options.title: Sponsor bundled distribution
options.body: Explicitly accept the new bundled provider/auth/catalog surface and authorize the workspace importer change after owner review of long-term support and dependency policy.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the PR and paired issue open until a provider/plugin owner confirms whether Turkish-hosted model routing is a supported bundled-provider priority.

recommendation.title: Use the external plugin path
recommendation.body: Keep OpenClaw core unchanged and publish the already-prepared LLMTR provider as an external plugin with installation, credential, update, and live smoke-proof guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context establishes an unresolved maintainer decision but does not identify a specific current-main provider/plugin owner reliably.
